item.title: Daily Wire Announces Star-Studded Cast for Upcoming Film Confession
item.description:
Daily Wire Announces Star-Studded Cast for Upcoming Film Confession

The Daily Wire has announced that its next film, Confession, will feature a star‑studded cast and is scheduled for release on Oct 14, 2026.

🎬 Overview

  • The Daily Wire has assembled a surprisingly star‑studded cast for its next film, Confession.
  • James Franco
  • Rob Lowe
  • Jennifer Jason Leigh
  • Written by Ben Shaprio
  • Produced by Karan Singh

📅 Release Details

  • Release date: Oct 14, 2026

🎟️ Ticketing & Box Office

  • Main Reception: +65 6348 5555
  • Box Office: +65 6348 5555
  • General Inquiries available during business hours
  • Will‑call tickets available at box office
  • Present valid identification for ticket collection
  • Arrive at least 30 minutes before event start time
  • Tickets held under customer name for reserved performances

🚗 Parking & Transportation

  • Limited on‑site parking available
  • Nearby paid parking facilities in the vicinity
  • Street parking available in surrounding areas
  • Public transportation recommended (MRT/Bus access nearby)
  • Valet parking may be available for special events

♿ Accessibility

  • Wheelchair accessible seats available
  • Accessible restroom facilities
  • Elevator access to all levels
  • Companion seating available
  • Advance notice recommended for accessibility requirements
  • Contact box office for specific seating arrangements

📜 Audience Policies

  • No outside food and beverages in concert hall
  • Mobile phones must be switched to silent mode
  • Photography and recording prohibited during performances
  • Latecomers may not be seated during performance
  • Dress code varies by event type

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family & Educational Options

  • Children under 2 years may not be admitted to certain performances
  • Age restrictions vary by event type
  • Family‑friendly performances available
  • Advance confirmation required for children’s attendance
  • Lap seating may be available for infants on specific shows
  • School matinee programs available for educational events

#DailyWire #ConfessionFilm #Entertainment #Cinema

Source: Min-Soo Sohn Tickets, Live at Victoria Concert Hall, Singapore on Oct 14, 2026 | Consequence Live
